newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in thin and directionless after-hours trade on Wednesday, as private investors were generally sidelined, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 0.7 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark April contract was 0.2 yen up at 142.7 yen. Volume was thin with 4,306 lots traded.
During the day, prices edged lower, as private investors were quick to take profits after recent price rises.
"Market focus is on the spot expiry on next Monday," a trading house trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7391
